title: 2016 AMC 10B Problem 21
statement: What is the area of the region enclosed by the graph of the equation \(x^2+y^2=|x|+|y|?\)

solutions.text:
The equation is symmetric in all four quadrants. In the first quadrant it becomes \[x^2+y^2=x+y,\] or \[(x-\tfrac12)^2+(y-\tfrac12)^2=\tfrac12.\]

In the first quadrant, the enclosed region is the triangle under \(x+y=1\), with area \(\frac12\), plus a semicircle of radius \(\sqrt{\frac{1}{2}}\), with area \(\frac\pi4\).

Multiplying by \(4\), the total area is \[4\left(\frac12+\frac\pi4\right)=2+\pi.\]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Work in one quadrant and multiply by \(4\)
The first-quadrant region is a triangle plus a semicircle
